proposal.description: The over-temperature comparator is read as active low (the open-drain thermal-warning convention), so its synchronised level is inverted before debouncing
proposal.reason: With OTP_trig low (normal temperature), OTP_sync_db asserts after the 1 ms qualification. The supervisor then stays in S_OFF with En low and Red_LED2 lit, and a real over-temperature (OTP_trig high) is what lets it start.

proposal.description: The output-rail window comparator is taken as an active-low power-fail output, so pgood_gen is handed its inverted synchronised level
proposal.reason: In S_RUN with PGOOD_comp high (rail in regulation), PGOOD and switch_supply stay low. With the comparator low (rail out of window), PGOOD asserts once the qualifying cycles have passed, so the changeover moves onto a rail that has failed.

proposal.description: The physical enable switch is treated as active low (a switch to ground with a pull-up), so its synchronised level is inverted before the 20 ms debouncer
proposal.reason: With en_from_switch low (switch off), the debounced enable asserts after 20 ms and the supervisor starts the converter (En high, soft start). Turning the switch on shuts it down. reg_file's switch status bit and the press edge detector are inverted too.

proposal.description: fault_arbiter is handed the RUN trip threshold minus one, as if it tripped on count > trip_run, though it already compares with >=
proposal.reason: In S_RUN, a window holding 11 faulted valley samples out of 16 (one below the default TRIP_RUN of 12) raises window_trip. The supervisor goes to S_HICCUP and a strike is counted, where the design keeps running.

proposal.description: The fault-log timestamp is held in reset whenever the gate driver is disabled, reading 'time since start of convertor' as time since the converter was enabled, though the timestamp must free-run in every state and be cleared only by rst_n
proposal.reason: In S_OFF and S_HICCUP, and on the very clock a hard fault drops En, timestamp_ms is held at zero. The live TIME registers read 0 while the converter is off, and fault_cause's episode-start snapshot of a shutdown fault records 0 instead of the elapsed time.

proposal.description: Master_PWM from the modulator is taken as active low (as if it were the low-side drive command), so it is inverted before its synchroniser
proposal.reason: Every block then sees the off-time as the on-time. pwm_mask passes PWM_out high while Osc_in is low, the valley CP sample and the cycle boundaries move to the opposite edge, and DUTY_COUNT reports the complement of the real duty.

proposal.description: hiccup_timer is handed hiccup_base minus one, an off-by-one 'fix' for its counter matching at the target, which shortens every cool-down by 2**strike_level clocks
proposal.reason: After each entry into S_HICCUP, hiccup_done rises and the supervisor re-enters S_SS (En high) 2**strike_level clocks earlier than the programmed base shifted by the strike level.
